purpose: Separate visual and motion concept preview; not wired into app startup.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait mobile app opening background, one visual concept, no UI.
Create a much more atmospheric, close-up mosque courtyard for the mature Nur Islam app. The visual language is elegant clean matte 3D illustration with softly bevelled forms, restrained detail and believable warm illumination, as in carefully art-directed premium app illustrations. Grown-up, peaceful, not a cartoon toy, not photorealistic.
Composition: tall portrait 2:3 canvas. Camera inside a quiet ivory-stone mosque arcade at courtyard level. A large uninterrupted deep emerald plaster wall fills the CENTER, from x18% to82%, y12% to76%, deliberately dark and calm enough for ivory app typography. The wall should feel spatial and architectural, not a blank digitally pasted panel. Frame it naturally with a close ivory-stone column at the far left edge and a graceful arch/arcade receding along the far right; partial framing architecture is intentional here, no distant miniature facade. At the far right bottom, a glimpse of a small teal dome and quiet courtyard may appear beyond the arcade, but keep them subordinate. Low warm stone paving occupies only the bottom 18%; a little restrained olive foliage at an extreme outer edge. Upper left sunlight creates a soft diagonal wash and delicate leaf shadows on the peripheral architecture. Keep the central writing area smooth, dark green, softly lit and uncluttered. Color family: emerald green, warm cream stone, muted teal, restrained gold sunlight. Rich warm afternoon atmosphere, high quality readable shapes and gentle depth. Scene designed for a slow almost imperceptible camera push-in.
No text, no letters, no Quran book, no people, no logo, no border, no ornamental patterns, no water feature. One full-bleed finished portrait background.
